A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AdamW-GS work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices are readable and matchable, including the renumbered appendix sections.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction-quality, primitive-count, runtime, and ablation results for 3DGS and related pipelines, including additional experiments in its appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including quantitative comparisons in Tables 1-30, optimization analyses, and rendering examples.

M1.justification: Sparse Adam, RSR, DAR, their combination as AdamW-GS, and the adaptations to other pipelines are retained. Section 4 and the implementation appendices specify the same components and update procedures.

E1.justification: Both evaluate Mip-NeRF360, Tanks&Temples, Deep Blending, and OMMO with the same scene coverage. The DBS Treehill exclusion and OMMO scene #10 preprocessing exclusion are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same Adam/Sparse Adam, 3DGS, 3DGS-MCMC, RePR, and MaskGaussian comparators, plus Taming-3DGS/DBS comparisons and AdamW-style regularization variants. Correcting 'MaskGaussion' to 'MaskGaussian' does not introduce a different baseline.

E3.justification: The every-eighth-image test split, PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS(vgg) metrics, primitive-count definitions, and training settings remain unchanged. Figure 9 and Tables 13-30 retain the same schedules, sampling probabilities, iteration ranges, and regularization configurations.

E4.justification: The AIU/RSR/DAR ablations, regularization and schedule sensitivity studies, ABE-Split and longer-densification experiments, and failure-case analyses already appear in v1 and are retained in v4. Appendix renumbering introduces no new analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions retain Figure 8's PSNR error bars unchanged; the scene-label correction does not alter uncertainty reporting. No run-count, seed, confidence-interval, significance-test, or uncertainty-estimation reporting is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1-30 retain the same numerical entries, and the plots and qualitative examples retain their results. For example, Table 3 reports MC8 PSNR of 28.219 and GS8 PSNR of 27.678 in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations 1-25 retain the same mathematical content, including optimizer updates, rendering definitions, and RSR scaling reasoning. No new or revised assumptions, derivations, or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: analyzing optimization coupling and proposing AdamW-GS to improve efficiency, reconstruction quality, and redundancy removal without additional pruning operations.

C2.justification: The mechanism interpretations and applicability limitations are retained. These include noise sensitivity, manually designed schedules, insufficient-view artifacts, geometric inconsistency, floaters, and failure under severe overfitting; v1 Appendix E becomes v4 Appendix G.

D1.justification: v4 adds a project-page link and Appendix A, a reproducibility guide pointing to dataset sources and existing method and hyperparameter sections. These are limited additions to access and navigation information; implementation details and hardware disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 45 referenced works and substantive relationships to prior optimization and Gaussian-splatting research are retained. Switching from numbered citations to author-year citations and alphabetizing references are presentation changes.

P1.justification: v4 makes limited grammatical, terminology, heading, and cross-reference corrections, and adds acknowledgments and short reproducibility and LLM-use sections. The main narrative and relative order of existing sections remain intact.

P2.justification: The one-column structure and existing displays are retained, with ICLR title/header formatting, typography changes, and some float relocation. Figure 4 explicitly names AdamW-GS in its legends, while Figures 2 and 8 correct method and scene labels.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly improves readability and navigation through copyediting, clearer figure legends, a project-page link, and Appendix A's guide to existing reproducibility information. The method, empirical evidence, and substantive limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gains are useful but limited.
